annotation.interpretation_a: All ServiceMode records are discarded; the resolver will not consider them at all.
annotation.interpretation_b: ServiceMode records are considered but have no effect on the resolution process; they are effectively masked by the AliasMode record.
annotation.justification: The word 'ignore' is open to interpretation. Does it mean to discard the records entirely, or to consider them but not act upon them? Both are reasonable interpretations, and the difference affects implementation.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether 'ignore' means to discard the records entirely or to simply not use them in the resolution process. This affects how a resolver would handle a mixed RRSet.
